extraction_notes: Catalog/job identity is retained in spaced form as CJ2301 S1. The supplied datasheet names the compatible base family CJ2301 and separately prints MARKING: S1; manufacturer, SOT-23 package, p-channel polarity, and 20-V drain-source rating agree with that catalog identity. S1 is treated as the package marking, not as an independently asserted datasheet suffix variant.

The PDF footer provides revision B, Apr, 2012. P-channel voltage and current quantities preserve the negative signs printed in the datasheet; resistance, capacitance, and other SI quantities use positive SI values.

Transfer, output, RDS(on), and source-drain diode curves on p. 3 are usable. Listed points are compact direct readings from the plotted traces at Ta = 25 degC, pulsed; no points were generated by interpolation.

The p. 2 Dynamic table directly labels Input capacitance Ciss = 405 pF, Output capacitance Coss = 75 pF, and Reverse transfer capacitance Crss = 55 pF; its merged VDS = -10 V, VGS = 0 V, f = 1 MHz test-condition cell applies to all three rows, with Ta = 25 degC from the table heading.
The catalog's Crss value of 10 pF at 10 V is not forced: the supplied PDF directly prints Crss, TYP, 55 pF under the shared capacitance-table condition, so the extracted SI value remains 5.5e-11 F.
The datasheet publishes no capacitance-versus-VDS figure; only tabulated Ciss, Coss, and Crss are transcribed.

RDS(on) table rows preserve both TYP and inclusive MAX values for both published VGS/ID conditions. The strict MOSFET schema has no fields for IDSS, IGSS, forward transconductance, gate charge, switching times, absolute maximum ratings, or thermal resistance; those values are not added outside schema.
